decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1569.01, 1569.02, 1569.PE03, 1569.PE04, 1569.PE05, 1569.PE06 A, 1569.PE09, 1569.PE11, Flood Risk Assessment prepared by Duffy Associates (unnumbered, no date), Design and Access Statement (1569PE/AF/D&A REV A). Received on 19 January 2016. Amended plans: 1569.PE07 B, 1569.PE08 B, 1569.PE10 B, 1569.PE12 B. Received on 24 February 2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of two single storey rear extensions to the house
